_comment: Copy to config.json and set your own paths. config.json is gitignored because these are internal network locations.

sources._comment: Unit trust daily valuation exports (HTML-based .XLS, one per fund per day)
Segregated mandate IPD reports (binary .xls), current rolling folder
Segregated mandate IPD reports, per-year archive folders
Anything manually dropped into the working folder (month-end files not in the archive, flat valuation CSVs)

_exclude_comment: Skip files whose name contains any of these — prices, settlements and trade files aren't holdings valuations
_names_comment: Some sources only carry a portfolio code (e.g. ABCDEF). Map codes to the fund name you present under.
_exclude_funds_comment: Funds to leave out entirely — e.g. mandates that have since closed
